title: Stop and claim readers read the lane manifest (ADR 0029 step 4)
body:
Evidence: ADR 0029 migration step 4 (docs/adr/0029-lane-manifest-and-task-writer.md, "Stop and claims on the manifest"); steps 1-3 merged (#1565 38d1399, #1572 5f52930). Today Stop and claim readers infer lane state from transcripts and raw claim files.
Outcome: recordedShip, laneRecords, laneWorktreeIn, claimedWorktree and ownerCheckout read the lane manifest (src/lane/manifest.ts); the manifest writer claims and releases through src/task/claims.ts; their transcript and raw claim reads are deleted (grep for the old readers prints 0 matches outside src/lane and src/task/claims.ts).
Proof: real-git tests: a lane started, shipped and dropped gives the same Stop verdicts as before through the manifest; a lane with no manifest keeps the legacy verdict.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/lane/manifest.ts, src/task/claims.ts, test/hook/, test/lane/
